_what: Site knowledge from the operator. Optional input. Rooms on one loop share one controller program in the fit; each room keeps its own building parameters. Facts here are what the operator says, not what the data showed - the fit tests them.

L1.name: Downstairs radiators
L1.operator_notes: Radiators. Most have no thermostatic valve. The TV room radiator has an analog thermostatic valve, almost closed.

L2.name: Upstairs floor heating
L2.operator_notes: Floor heating. Kitchen also gets warm air rising from downstairs through the open space and balcony.

rooms.tv: downstairs, radiator (L1) with an analog thermostatic valve, almost closed

expectations: TV room: small direct heating share from L1 (valve almost closed); a local room-feedback structure there would be a real thermostatic valve, not a false positive.
Fireplace room: mostly L1, plus fireplace events.
Kitchen: mostly L2, plus warm air from downstairs.
